name: Chronicle Keeper
lore: A patient keeper of misplaced seconds, whose brass hourglass turns battlefield positions into promises.

primary.name: Second Needle
primary.description: Fire a clock needle for 19 damage. A hit stores that foe’s position for 4s, up to 3 marked foes. Repeated hits refresh the mark without replacing its first position.

secondary.name: Rewind Chime
secondary.description: Consume your marks within 550 reach: each foe takes 24 damage, is stunned for 0.5s and slides back toward its recorded position. Walls stop the rewind; bosses take damage and stun but cannot be moved.

special.name: Borrowed Moment
special.description: Place a 130-radius hourglass field up to 250 ahead. For 2s it slows foes by 30% and holds up to 6 moving hostile bullets. Then burst for 40 damage plus 4 per held bullet (maximum 64). Walls block the field; lobbed bombs and beams are not captured.

passive: Patient Hands: Second Needle marks last 6 seconds instead of 4, giving you more time to set up a rewind.

technique.name: Restorative Rewind
technique.description: Rewind Chime heals you for 2 health per rewound foe (up to 6), but deals 25% less damage. Displacement and stun stay the same.

final_technique.name: Midnight Meridian
final_technique.description: Replace the bullet-catching field with a narrow, piercing clock ray: 80 damage, 550 reach and a 0.8s stun after a visible 1s charge. Loses bullet capture and area slow; 16s cooldown.

attack.name: Midnight Meridian
attack.description: A clock hand draws the line for 1s before a piercing ray hits for 80 damage and stuns for 0.8s. No capture or slow field.
